component.name: Cassette Deck
component.summary: Photorealistic cassette player for local music

description.p: A photoreal 1980s portable cassette player for your local music library, built as a native COSMIC application. The deck is a photograph, and the app draws the living parts on top every frame.

ul.li: Animated reels driven by physically derived spool speeds: the source reel empties and speeds up while the take-up slows
Click a cassette case and it hinges open, the tape lifts out, and it drops into the deck before playback begins
A dynamic track label rasterized from your file tags
Five colour skins, and swappable room backgrounds you can add your own images to
Cassette Rack: fan through your albums with cover art from your tags, or scraped when a tag has none
Mechanical sound: the transport keys click, the tape seats with a clunk, and holding fast-forward or rewind whirrs
MPRIS support for media keys, playerctl, and desktop panel controls
Plays MP3, FLAC, M4A/AAC, and WAV
